from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class University(BaseModel):
    """One university's enrollment and admission statistics."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The university name")
    total_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Total enrollment figure (Section B1)")
    first_year_admitted: int | None = Field(description="Admitted first-time, first-year degree-seeking students (Section C1)")
    transfer_admitted: int | None = Field(description="Admitted transfer degree-seeking students (Section D2)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[University]
